_unknown_required_question: leave_to_human: fill validated fields and list required questions for you; stop: fill nothing when a required question is unknown. Never submits either way.
_tick_required_consents: false (default): consent and terms boxes are left to you and listed with what remains to do. true: tick the boxes the form marks as required (policy/terms acknowledgement); never newsletter/marketing/future-opportunity boxes.
_prefill_mode: chrome_tab: new tabs in your own Chrome, filled by the Fitly extension; window: separate Chrome window driven by Playwright.
